svg.text: finbot: the model writes, code decides
A fintech support bot on Amazon Bedrock. Every claim about someone's money is checked against the records first.
asks about an account, transfer, card, loan …
signs the token the API verifies

text.tspan: API verifies the token; tenant, role and groups come from it, never from the chat text

svg.text: then: per-session FIFO turn queue (SQS) · de-duplicated by message id
Stateless worker: one turn, in this order
before anything else sees the text
a session that kept attacking goes to a person
prompt attacks, denied topics, PII · Bedrock Guardrails
every check reads English; other languages go to a person
escalate complaints and hardship; block learned attacks
which record this turn is about, decided in code
refund, cancel, unblock, appeal … becomes a ticket
drafts an answer from tool results only
verify · one repair · answer built from the record · refuse
compare-and-swap on version and lease · audit line
circuit breaker per model · 90 s turn deadline
a backup model gets the same checks
scoped to the tenant in the token
Systems of record and help pages
core banking · cards · KYC · loans · billing · claims
indexed help pages, cited by URL
rule proposed, then gated on evals
admin approves; rollback in one call
Stages 1–7 and 9–11 are plain Python: the same input gets the same decision every time. Only stage 8 uses the model.
finbot · open source · synthetic data · github.com/tokencraftdata/finbot
